name.t: Snow globe with photograph and message

summary.t: Plywood snow globe with photograph and personalised message in golden acrylic.

text.t: Personalised Snow Globe with Photograph, a decorative piece made from pine plywood, personalised with a special photograph and a message on a golden acrylic plate. Featuring a decorative velvet or tartan fabric ribbon and a delicate golden bell, it is a unique and charming keepsake, perfect for celebrating Christmas and preserving your most special family moments.

options.base.help.t: Send the photograph after ordering: simply reply to the confirmation email with it.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
